subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

It’s Christmas and everything looks so beautiful. It makes me believe that __life is wonderful and pleasant__.

options.text: life is a bowl of cherries

solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"beautiful"** means pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically. (सुंदर)

 
 
• **Example: **The garden looked **beautiful** with all the blooming flowers.
 
 
 
• **"Life is a bowl of cherries"** refers to life being very pleasant and enjoyable. (जीवन आनंदमय है)
 
 
• **Example: **Ever since she got her dream job, she feels like** life is a bowl of cherries.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct idiom for the given phrase is **'life is a bowl of cherries.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **I'm up in the air** (मैं अनिश्चित हूं): Feeling uncertain or undecided.

 
 
• **Example:** **I’m up in the air **about whether to accept the job offer or not.
 
 
 
• **I'm facing the music** (मैं परिणामों का सामना कर रहा हूं): Facing the consequences of one's actions.
 
 
• **Example: **After skipping classes all semester, he had **to face the music **when the exam results were announced.
 
 
 
• **I'm changing my tune** (मैं अपना विचार बदल रहा हूं): Changing one's opinion or attitude.
 
 
• **Example:** He was against the project initially, but now **he’s changing his tune** after seeing its success.
